answer: Every identity stands on a ledge it must re-earn each epoch by a fresh pulse of judged work; let the pulse lapse and your standing decays. A falcon's-eye attacker spanning many accounts cannot share one account's effort across the flock — each must separately produce, be graded by unbribable peers, and renew. The public record of these pulses is replayable, so bought or copied standing is visible to anyone who checks.
